name: Lil' Monsta
ability: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]
designRole: Minions choose a babysitter who counts as the Demon; extra Minion and Storyteller-chosen deaths.
explanation: Minions choose a babysitter who counts as the Demon; extra Minion and Storyteller-chosen deaths.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens.
nightInstructions.otherNights: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens. A player might die. :reminder:

storytellerNotes: No ordinary player holds the Demon character. Review babysitting, extra Minion setup and Storyteller kills.

jinxes.reason: If the Hatter dies & the Demon chooses Lil' Monsta, they also choose a Minion to become.
If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
If the Psychopath is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, the Scarlet Woman babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game.
If the Vizier is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
